A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MoM study, with all 18 pages and Appendices A–I available. Scientific text, equations, tables and figures match; only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its link differ.

before.justification: v3 reports original MoM benchmark results in Tables 2–3, ablations in Section 4.2, and training-loss, hybrid, fairness and scaling results in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original MoM benchmark, ablation and appendix results, including the hybrid comparison in Table 8 and equal-parameter comparison in Table 9.

M1.justification: Top-k routing, selective memory updates, shared memory, weighted mixing and varlen execution in Sections 3.2–3.3 are identical. Appendix F's hybrid architecture is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SlimPajama training data, recall-intensive benchmarks, LongBench tasks, commonsense benchmarks and FineWeb length-extrapolation scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including Transformer++, RetNet, HGRN2, GLA, GSA and Gated DeltaNet in Tables 2 and 7.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model configurations, metrics and evaluation controls are unchanged, including the 2K recall-input truncation, extrapolation to 32K and Appendix G's fairness settings.

E4.justification: The memory-expansion comparisons, auxiliary-loss and shared-memory ablations, routing analyses, extrapolation tests, and appendix training-loss, fairness and scaling analyses are identical.

E5.justification: Seed and statistical reporting are unchanged, including Figure 7's fixed random seed of 42. No repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings match. For example, Table 2 retains MoM recall-task averages of 28.16 for the 380M configuration and 36.04 for the 1.3B configuration.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8, Table 1's memory-update rules and Section 3.3's indexing and reconstruction mathematics are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about memory capacity, interference, computational efficiency and performance relative to linear models and Transformers.

C2.justification: Interpretations of memory separation, routing specialization and scaling remain identical, as do Appendix G's qualifications about matching parameter counts and memory capacity.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, optimizer settings, hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures are unchanged. Both code-repository links also retain the same targets.

R1.justification: The references and research positioning are identical, including Appendix A's related work and Appendix B's distinction between MoM and MoE.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3, dated 9 Oct 2025, to v4, dated 18 Nov 2025, with its corresponding version link. Prose, title, authors and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–10 retain identical displays, captions and placement. Rendered pages 2–18 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the marginal version/date text.

improvement.justification: The main text and appendices contain identical methods, evidence, interpretations and reproducibility information. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and link produces no meaningful difference in scientific or editorial quality.
